title: Enforce required gates during work and sprint closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Work close refuses missing or failed required gates unless a forced bypass has reason and comment.
Sprint, phase, and milestone closeout refuse unresolved required gates and unresolved descendant work unless explicitly forced by policy.
Regression tests cover direct runtime callers and CLI closeout paths.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code.
closedReason: required closeout gates are enforced during work and sprint closeout with regression coverage
